docs.title: MOSAIC — Multi Method Open Chromatin Solver for ATAC-seq Inference of Composition
docs.text: Mosaic is a cell-type deconvolution tool for ATAC-seq based transcriptomic data which targets the current methodological gap between classical statistical methods and heavy Transformer-based methods currently available in the domain.

docs.title: Benchmarks
docs.text: Benchmarks using data from studies Granja et. al. 2019 and Satpathy et. al. 2019.

docs.title: Loading Data
docs.text: Load ATAC-seq data via AnnData (h5ad preferred), or directly from fragments.

docs.title: Predicting
docs.text: Predict cell-type proportions on ATAC-seq data using a single model, or using a consensus prediction from multiple models.
